triples.subject: ClinicalAngleAssessment
triples.context: Clinical angle assessment.We measure (1) Mean Absolute Error (MAE) between predicted and ground-truth angles; (2) the Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC(2,1)), a two-way random effects model quantifying absolute agreement by partitioning variance into between-subject variability, between-rater systematic bias, and residual error through ANOV A decomposition of the paired measurements (model vs. clinician).
